sourceFunctions.ready_up_tellraw:
execute unless score playersReady variables >= players variables run tellraw @a {fallback:"All players can drop their ready up item when they are ready to begin the game.",translate:"mcp.ready_up_tellraw.1",color:"#FF2424",type:"translatable"}
execute unless score playersReady variables >= players variables run playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup master @a ~ ~ ~ 10 2 1

growth.fill: air only, inclusive Y between markerY-1 and53; fail the entire fill outside original End0..255

release.compensation: 2 if total tune count>=2, 1 if count==1, otherwise0
release.markerBarrierCommands: No effect: all markers have already been killed before these selectors run.

scoring.raw: TowerHeight: compensation plus each owned native colored falling_block whose floor(PosY)<=56
scoring.ranking: Final Points is assigned TowerHeight after the source's intermediate ranking tellraw; five-game round ranking uses final TowerHeight.

adaptations: Read per-round tune-stat deltas without resetting players' permanent custom statistics.
Any active local note block may be tuned; the clicking player's own tower grows, matching source player-stat attribution.
Only local player state, owned tower entities and tracked blocks are modified; no global objectives, teams, schedules or gamerules run.
Native falling entities retain gravity, collisions, tripwire landing behavior and source doEntityDrops=false via their own dropItem flag.
Original End build-height rejection and below-End entity expiration are translated to this round's arena coordinates.
The source solo60/70/80 achievement threshold is outside the multiplayer match mode; raw tower-height scoring is unchanged.
